title: Implementation Engineer II (MS-SQL Developer, RDBMS,T-SQL)
description:
Our fast-paced and collaborative environment inspires us to create, think, and challenge each other in ways that make our solutions and our teams better. Whether you’re interested in engineering or development, marketing or sales, or something else – if this sounds like you, then we’d love to hear from you!

We are headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with offices in the US, Canada, and India.

**The insurance industry runs on Vertafore.** We equip agencies, MGAs, and carriers with the core digital systems, specialized AI, and data-driven foundation to eliminate distribution drag across the insurance lifecycle, spanning sales, servicing, and back-office operations.

Underpinned by unmatched speed and performance power, we are the trusted backbone that’s taking the insurance industry from friction to flow with **Distribution Velocity** –speed, performance, and trust - to drive growth at scale.

With over 95% of the top agencies and insurers and 50% of industry compliance transactions running through Vertafore, **we lead at the intersection of innovation and trust**, giving insurance professionals the confidence to transform and win in the AI era.

Our reach is global, with headquarters in Denver, Colorado, and offices across the U.S., Canada, and India.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Vertafore employee in Implementation Engineer position would deliver value to customers through implementation, technical configurations, and providing technical recommendations and solutions to business problems. They shape and improve the experience of key Vertafore clients. They work cross-functionally across Vertafore, including Customer Support, Account Management, Professional Services and Product Management to help guide the client and also contribute to future growth of Services team.

Being part of a cross-functional team to serve key clients, Implementation Engineer needs to be a proactive self-starter, able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment and service-focused to help nurture the client experience. Additionally, one loves getting into the technical details of an implementation and are excited to come up with new tools, processes, or solution to complex problems.

Implementation Engineers focus on configurations and customizations required by clients of Vertafore products, and work on release items for clients,

**Core Requirements and Responsibilities:**

Essential job functions included but are not limited to the following:

* Develop forward thinking, technical implementation recommendations that align with clients' business objectives.

* Configure, create, and demonstrate the technical components of the Vertafore product suite using tools and expertise in the areas of system configuration, web services, JavaScript/jQuery.

* Configures data conversion environment and does the integration configurations for inbound and outbound based on the implementation needs

* Configure the product based on the implementation requirements

* Configure or design the required complex reports or integrations

* Ability to consume, configure and/or develop the product Web API based on the customer requirements.

* Maintains the deepest level of industry and product expertise and proliferates, internally and externally.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 – 3.8 years of work experience in a technical, customer focused environment.

* Advanced written and verbal communication skills

* Technically savvy with an interest in technology and in deepening technical and software knowledge

* Strong experience with RDBMS Data Structures and database concepts, preferably - SQL

* Experience with Java script functions as needed using the jQuery

* Experience with Web config files with appropriate App Pools, End Points, App Settings

* Experience with ETL tools

**Additional Requirements and Details:**

* Located and working from an office location.

* Occasional lifting and/or moving up to 10 pounds.

* Frequent repetitive hand and arm movements required to operate a computer.

* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision (working on a computer, etc.).

* Frequent sitting and/or standing.

Other times, our teams work from home or a similar environment.

title: Python( AI/ML Developer ) 2 to 6 Years
description:
**Job Description**We are looking for a **Pro Python Developer** who is passionate about building high\-quality, scalable, and efficient applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and backend development, with experience in APIs, microservices, and system integrations.While the primary focus of this role is **Python development**, candidates with **experience in AI/ML model development** (using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit\-learn) will be highly valued. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including data engineers and software developers, to deliver robust solutions and, where applicable, integrate AI\-driven features into our applications and business processes.​​**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, and maintain robust Python applications** with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* **Write clean, reusable, and efficient code** while following best practices, coding standards, and version control workflows (Git).
* **Work with databases** (SQL, NoSQL) to design schemas, optimise queries, and ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
* **Build and optimise APIs / microservices** for seamless integration across platforms and applications.
* **Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams** (frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps) to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* **Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines** for smooth deployment and testing workflows.
* **Troubleshoot, debug, and optimise existing systems to ensure** high availability and security compliance.
* **(Plus: AI/ML Expertise)** – Develop and deploy AI/ML models using frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit\-learn, design data pipelines, and integrate models into production systems.
* Stay updated with the latest **Python ecosystem advancements** and, if applicable, trends in AI/ML to continuously improve solutions.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: Up to ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer
description:
**Experience:** 4\-8 Years
**Vacancy:** 1
**Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Gandhinagar


We are seeking a highly skilled AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer who can both architect and build enterprise\-grade AI solutions. This is a hands\-on role requiring deep technical expertise in Generative AI, Microsoft AI technologies, application development, automation, and data analytics.


The ideal candidate will have experience designing and implementing AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents, workflow automation solutions, and business productivity tools leveraging Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, and Microsoft Power Platform. The candidate should be capable of independently taking solutions from concept to deployment.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


**AI Solution Architecture \& Development**


* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI and OpenAI APIs.
* Architect and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Build AI agents and multi\-agent workflows for business use cases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and reusable AI components.
* Design secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources and business applications.
* Implement monitoring, evaluation, and optimization strategies for AI solutions.


**Microsoft AI \& Copilot Ecosystem**


* Build custom solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Develop Copilot extensions, plugins, and custom actions.
* Leverage Azure AI Foundry for AI application development and deployment.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Dynamics environments.
* Utilize Microsoft Graph APIs to connect enterprise systems and data.


**Application Development**


* Develop backend services using Python.
* Design and consume REST APIs.
* Build AI\-powered web applications and automation tools.
* Develop integrations using JSON\-based APIs and cloud services.
* Create lightweight front\-end interfaces using JavaScript where required.


**Automation \& Productivity Solutions**


* Develop Excel\-based AI tools and add\-ins.
* Automate business workflows using Power Automate.
* Build low\-code applications using Power Apps.
* Create Office Scripts and Excel automation solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end automation workflows for finance, operations, and compliance functions.


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**


* Build data processing pipelines using Python and Pandas.
* Design and maintain data models and database schemas.
* Develop dashboards and insights using Power BI.
* Perform structured and unstructured data analysis.
* Optimize solutions for performance, scalability, and usability.

**Required Technical Skills****:**
----------------------------------


**AI \& Generative AI**


Must have hands\-on experience with:


* Azure OpenAI Services, OpenAI APIs, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agent Development, LLM Application Development, Vector Databases and Semantic Search, AI Governance and Responsible AI practices


**Programming \& Development**


* Advanced Python development, SQL and database querying, REST API development and integration, JSON data structures and API payload design, JavaScript (Basic to Intermediate), Git Version Control, Object\-Oriented Programming principles


**Microsoft Ecosystem**


* Excel Automation, Office Scripts, Power Automate, Power Apps, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft 365 Integrations, Copilot Extensibility, SharePoint Online Integrations


**Data \& Analytics**


* Pandas, Power BI, Data Modelling, Database Design, Data Transformation, Business Intelligence Reporting

**Required Experience****:**
----------------------------


* 4\-8 years of software development, automation, or solution architecture experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Generative AI solution development.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in Azure environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems using APIs.
* Proven experience developing automation and productivity solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured business data.

**Preferred Experience****:**
-----------------------------


Experience building solutions such as:


* Excel add\-ins integrated with Azure OpenAI
* AI\-powered financial analysis tools
* Valuation modelling assistants built using Python and LLMs
* Financial statement extraction and processing tools
* Automated report review and summarization agents
* Contract review and compliance agents
* Knowledge management and enterprise search solutions
* Copilot\-based business productivity assistants
* Workflow automation solutions powered by AI agents

**Soft Skills****:**
--------------------


* Strong solution architecture mindset
* Ability to translate business problems into AI\-powered solutions
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Self\-driven and capable of independently delivering projects
* Ability to mentor junior developers and lead technical discussions

**Success Criteria****:**
-------------------------


The successful candidate should be able to:


* Independently design and build production\-ready AI solutions.
* Develop and deploy RAG\-based applications and AI agents.
* Create Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI solutions.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions from architecture through deployment.
* Build practical business applications that generate measurable productivity and efficiency gains.


**Ideal Profile:** A hands\-on AI engineer who combines the capabilities of a Solution Architect, AI Developer, Automation Specialist, and Microsoft Platform Expert, with the ability to build real\-world business solutions rather than only designing them.
